title: רב שמעיה בר זירא

paragraphs: Rav Shemayah bar Zeira: Pesahim 7a. Rava sent by Rav Shemayah bar Zeira: Ketubbot 81a. In Hullin 116, Eruvin 93a, and Bava Metzia 26a: Rav Shemayah bar Ze'ira. It seems to me that he is bar Zeira; the Gemara's manner is to omit the ayin, and it is Ze'ira. So too in the Jerusalem Talmud, and Ze'ira should be read with a hiriq. In Nazir 52; Pesahim 23, 25, 27, 49: Rav Shemayah, and he is bar Ze'ira. In Kiddushin 76b: R' Shimon bar Zeira taught in the Kiddushin collection of Levi's academy. It is a scribal error and should read Shemayah; see below, Sherevyah. In Yuhasin: “R' Shemayah bar Zirtanai, Asarah Yuhasin”; see the later edition of Nahalat Shiv'ah. It is a scribal error and should read the foregoing “bar Zeira taught.” A trustworthy witness is that Yuhasin did not bring Rav Shemayah bar Zeira at all.
